transcript.message: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy, this is Maya on the new-patient line. If this is a medical emergency, please hang up and call 911. How can I help you today?
Hi, yeah - I just need a refill on my muscle relaxer, my doctor's out of town and I'm having back spasms.

I'm sorry your back is bothering you. I can't help with prescription refills, but I can help you book a physical therapy evaluation for your back. What's the best callback number for you, starting with the area code?
Uh, physical therapy? No, I just need a refill. Can you transfer me to someone who can help with that?

I'm not able to transfer you, and I can't handle prescriptions. Your pharmacist or the office of the doctor who prescribed it can help with a refill, and many doctors have an on-call service when they're away. If you'd like, I can still note your number so our team can follow up, so what's the best callback number?
Ok, so you're saying call the doctor's on-call line? That actually makes sense, I didn't think of that.
Yes, that's a good next step. Before you go, could you give me a callback number so I can log your call with our team?
Uh, sure - 713-555-0115. But yeah, I think I'm good, I'll just call the on-call line.
